name: techdella/myth-fact
title: Myth vs fact
description: Pairs of a common myth and the fact, side by side.

items.myth: SEO is dead because of AI answers.
items.fact: AI answers draw on pages that rank and are clearly written. SEO foundations matter more, not less.

items.myth: More content always means more traffic.
items.fact: Thin pages can drag a site down. Fewer, better pages that answer real questions win.

techdella.help: items: 2–5 {myth, fact}. Lead the fact with the correction, then one line of why; cite a source in the text when you state a number.
